title: Pan-Seared Pork Dumplings
description: A quick and delicious Chinese-inspired dish featuring juicy pork dumplings pan-seared to perfection.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Once the pork is browned, add the dumplings to the skillet and cook until they're golden brown on the bottom.
Add 1/2 cup of water to the skillet and cover with a lid.
Steam the dumplings for 5-7 minutes, or until they're cooked through.
Remove the lid and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the dumplings are golden brown on the top.
Serve the dumplings hot with soy sauce, sesame oil, chopped scallions, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
